Data and sources

What the numbers and photos represent.

Shopping and prices

Choose Canada for CAD or the United States for USD. Buying links are available for every catalog entry. Search links do not guarantee availability or a matching variant.

Checked prices are time-stamped snapshots of exact retailer listings. They expire after 15 minutes and are not automatically refreshed continuously. Lowest checked price means the lowest among the displayed offers, not every retailer. Coverage is limited while more product listings and retailer feeds are connected.

Build subtotals include only parts with a valid checked price, including repeated items. Missing prices are excluded and counted separately. Taxes, shipping, coupons, mail-in rebates and membership discounts are not included. Confirm final pricing and stock at checkout.

Specifications & missing data

Each part links to its source. Charts use a shared unit and start at zero. A dash means unavailable, not zero. Product names, years, and specifications come from the existing catalog; source availability can change.

PC performance evidence

PC results default to insufficient benchmark evidence. The optional legacy model uses assumed workload and synthetic-score inputs; it has not been calibrated against a permitted measured game dataset. It has no demonstrated prediction error. The fixed variance range, derived 1% low and universal bottleneck labels are removed.

Read the record schema, coverage and testing protocol. Console modes remain source-linked targets or caps rather than a guarantee of sustained FPS.

Console performance evidence

Each game and exact console key has its own source record and edition scope. Published targets, caps, unlocked base rates and original-author observations have different labels; none is a site-measured average. Unknown FPS remains withheld. Open Evidence and conditions on a card for display requirements, player count, source date and coverage limitations.

Historical targets do not guarantee current-patch performance. A 120 Hz output mode does not by itself establish 120 FPS. Grouped console labels do not establish evidence for every hardware revision.

Compatibility evidence and limits

The Build Readiness Report uses exact documented fields for a limited set of models. It separates narrow passed checks, documented conflicts, missing evidence and checks outside the picker. Catalog numbers and a shared socket do not prove exact BIOS support, cable compatibility or installed clearance.

Power planning based on published ratings is not a measured wall-power result. 3D meshes are visual aids, without clearance certification. No readiness percentage or calibrated hardware tier is claimed. Read the checks and enter manual dimensions.

Product images

Photos may show the selected product or a related variant. Each product page names the model pictured and links to its image source. Confirm the exact appearance with the manufacturer before buying.

Morning price checks

Morning-checked prices use a separate daily snapshot policy. Each observation identifies the exact variant, merchant, seller, country, currency, online availability and check time. Eligible observations expire after at most 24 hours; current checked offers elsewhere still expire after 15 minutes.

A purchase subtotal includes quantities and excludes owned parts. Missing prices remain unknown. The lowest checked item price covers only connected stores and excludes tax and shipping. It is not a guaranteed checkout price or a claim to cover every merchant.

Automatic morning collection is not active while retailer access and storage are unconfigured. Unavailable checks do not produce prices, discounts or availability claims. A source failure keeps prior observations visibly dated; expired observations do not qualify for a current daily subtotal.
